fields.spec_version: USB Power Delivery Specification Revision 3.1, Version 1.8 (USB-IF)

lineage.summary: Original PD over VBUS using BFSK; superseded by CC-based PD.
BMC on the Type-C CC wire; Fixed/Variable/Battery PDOs.
Adds Programmable Power Supply (PPS / APDO), extended messages, fast role swap.
Extended Power Range up to 240 W (48 V at 5 A).

backward_compat_traps.rule: USB-PD negotiates power/role over the CC wire with BMC; it is NOT the USB 2.0 D+/D- data bus (NRZI, PID, endpoints, SOF).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Decoding USB-PD as USB 2.0 data (looking for D+/D-, NRZI, endpoints) is wrong — PD lives on CC.

backward_compat_traps.rule: USB-PD only negotiates power and roles; it does NOT tunnel USB 3.x / DisplayPort / PCIe at 20/40/80 Gbps like USB4 routers.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating the CC/VCONN pins as the USB4 high-speed tunneling fabric misses that PD is a low-speed contract protocol.
